title: Care Program Credit to the OTC Allowance for Care Management Participants
content:
Under the Pharmacy Benefit, a care program credit is added to the quarter load of the over-the-counter allowance of a member taking part in certain Care Management programs.

**Rule.** The care program credit is four dollars ($4.00) for a member with an active Maternal Care Management care episode, two dollars ($2.00) for a member with an active Healthy Living Support care episode, and nothing otherwise.

The episode read is the member's Care Management episode in active status and its tier.

### Credit table

| Active Care Management episode | Care program credit added to the quarter load |
|---|---|
| Maternal Care Management | $4.00 |
| Healthy Living Support | $2.00 |
| Any other tier, or no active episode | Nothing |

### Points of judgement

*A member's Maternal Care Management episode has closed and no episode is active.* Nothing: the credit reads the active episode only.

*A member has an active Care Coordination Level 1 episode.* Nothing: only the two tiers named above earn a credit.
